Shoot-day checklist (high priority):
- 8:00 crew call / 8:30 first setup
- Vetted entry badges for crew + sign-in sheet (Elena will provide site contact)
- Interview room: quiet, low-echo, chairs for Jordan and interviewer; two-camera angles (wide + tight)
- Sound: lav + boom as backup; sound check 15 min before first interview
- Power & connectivity: bring battery pack for camera + laptop for screen capture
- B-roll: product in use (no PII), office exteriors, team interactions (natural light preferred)
- Consent: in-person signing of talent_release_luma_draft.docx; bring printed copies + pens

Shot list (high level):
1) Jordan interview — 4–6 questions, ~8–10 soundbites total (we'll shape in edit)
2) Priya ops cutaways — 3 short statements for technical credibility
3) B-roll: dashboard interactions, whiteboard session, team in meeting, hands typing (synthetic data)
4) Logo/branding shots and controlled social cutdowns

Questions for Elena: who will be the on-site point of contact for sign-in and compliance? Also confirm if employees need to sign releases or only on-camera talent.

Thanks,
Monica
